purpose: The header row of a Modal: an optional featured icon, the title that names the dialog, its description and an optional trailing slot for header actions or a count.

notFor.case: A heading for a page or a card outside a dialog.

Default.meaning: Static; Align and Size set the layout.
Default.visual: Title Content/primary, description Content/secondary; the icon is a FeaturedIcon (rounded).

a11y.role: none of its own; the title is the Modal's aria-labelledby and the description its aria-describedby
a11y.keyboard: No tab stop of its own; controls in the trailing slot take focus.
notes: Never hide the title: it is the dialog's name.

openQuestions: Which heading level does the title render as? The contract does not say.
